context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package's SSL/TLS configuration options to handle custom certificates, control validation, and implement mutual TLS authentication.

checklist.name: strictSSL option
checklist.description: Uses strictSSL or rejectUnauthorized option to control certificate validation

checklist.name: CA certificate
checklist.description: Provides custom CA certificate(s) using the ca option with file contents

checklist.name: Client certificate
checklist.description: Provides client certificate using cert option for mutual TLS

checklist.name: Private key
checklist.description: Provides private key using key option along with client certificate

checklist.name: Certificate loading
checklist.description: Reads certificate files from filesystem (e.g., using fs.readFileSync) before passing to options
